hooks.text: 海量敌潮配合荒诞武器持续扩张火力
hooks.excerpt: Thousands — or even hundreds of thousands of defeated enemies in a single match, taken down by all kinds of methods: from a good old shotgun to complete absurdity like dual miniguns and lasers shooting from your eyes.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 角色枪械与三类武器在局内同步成长
hooks.excerpt: Throughout the match, you upgrade not only your Shadow Cat Warrior and their ShadowGun, but also gain access to an entire arsenal of magical, melee, and firearms that will help you give the darkness a worthy fight.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 死亡后继续解锁物品并重组下局
hooks.excerpt: Die and be reborn — because every match will unlock more and more new items and artifacts, all accompanied by random generation, making every run truly unique.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 独立游戏画面表现出乎意料地好。

excerpts.excerpt: the graphics are surprisingly good for an indie title.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: the learning curve can be steep at times.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 大量物品使新手初期很难进入状态。

excerpts.excerpt: This game is not for beginners—it can be tough to get into at first due to the large number of items.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 游戏开局阶段可能略显无聊。

excerpts.excerpt: In the beginning, the game might feel a bit boring.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 策略与动作的结合让人感到新鲜。

excerpts.excerpt: a compelling mix of strategy and action that I found refreshing.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 关卡设计周到，每次遭遇都具备独特挑战和回报。

excerpts.excerpt: The level design is well thought out, making each encounter uniquely challenging and rewarding.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 故事能够持续吸引玩家。
